narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona and a trough of low pressure passing through Utah made for a rather active day across the area. Thunderstorms produce heavy rain, high winds, and small hail.
ev: Heavy rain in Utah caused a two foot rise on the Paria River just before it joined the Colorado River at Lees Ferry.
Tonto Rreek rose 2.25 feet between 730 AM and 800 AM about 10 miles south of Gisela.
Cataract Creek/Havasu Creek rose 18 inches at the Supai Gauge.
Agua Fria River rose 8 feet near Humboldt at 515 PM and then rose 4 feet near Cordes Junction rose 4 feet at 815 PM.
Rincon Road at Hassayampa River (normally dry) was close due to flooding. The stream gauge on Martinez Wash at Whickenburg showed a 2 foot rise to 700 CFS rise on this normally dry wash.

Heavy rain caused flash flooding on Big Bug Creek. The water rose to the level of the bridge in Spring Valley. The water almost overtopped South Spring Lane at 635 PM. Photos on social media showed flooding in other areas of the community.
